currency.basis: Live fetches 2026-10-05 of bingx.com favicon.ico and apple-touch-icon.png and the current main branch of BingX-API/docs-v3 all show the same X mark in current use.

identity.basis: bingx.com homepage is the operating BingX exchange site (og:site_name 'BingX'); favicon and apple-touch-icon served from the same domain show the X mark; the vector comes from BingX's own GitHub org docs repo. Single official publication origin for all three.

assessment.independenceRationale: All confirming sources are BingX-controlled publications (bingx.com domain and BingX-API GitHub org); identity does not rest on third-party vector sites. Third-party hosts (seeklogo, iconlogovector, logotyp.us) were observed only in search results and not used.

variant.basis: Current standalone symbol is the blue X glyph on transparent background (docs vector mark; favicon). App icon applies it white-on-blue-square as platform presentation. The accepted SVG instead cuts the X out of a solid blue circle — a different presentation of the same motif.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Both curved strokes and their crossing overlap reproduce the source mark exactly; the subtle radial-gradient darkening on the upper stroke is present; fills match #2A54FF; background fully transparent.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Original mark aspect (28.0065 x 21.8043) preserved; centered by the catalog's square-cell fit without stretching; margins come from the cell, not altered geometry.
candidate.rationale: Original vector from BingX's official GitHub organization (BingX-API/docs-v3 static/logo.svg): the standalone X mark, losslessly subset from the official lockup with original paths, #2A54FF fills and the 0.3-opacity radial-gradient overlay preserved. Standalone brand mark without accompanying text; square-cell suitable. The accepted icon presents the same X motif cut out of a solid blue circle, a presentation that matches no observed current official presentation (favicon: blue X on transparent; app icon: white X on blue field). Supported current-design update.
candidate.role: standalone brand mark (official docs logo mark; favicon/app-icon glyph)
transforms: Lossless subset of the official lockup SVG: kept the three mark paths (two #2A54FF strokes, one opacity-0.3 radial-gradient overlay) and the original radialGradient defs; wordmark paths removed; viewBox tightened to the mark bounds 0 0 28.0065 21.8043. No geometry, color or paint edits.

candidate.variant: blue X glyph, transparent background, #2A54FF with radial-gradient shading on the upper stroke
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Accepted icon: white X cut out of a solid blue circle. Replacement: the official standalone blue X glyph on transparent background, without the circle backing. Same motif, different supported presentation.

proposals.reason: Official BingX standalone mark is the blue X glyph (two interlocking curved strokes, #2A54FF with a subtle radial-gradient overlay), published as original vector in BingX's own GitHub docs repo (BingX-API/docs-v3 static/logo.svg lockup, mark subset) and confirmed as the current variant by bingx.com favicon.ico (blue X on transparent, #0047FF-rendered) and apple-touch-icon.png (white X on blue field). The accepted SVG presents the same X motif cut out of a solid blue circle — a presentation variant that does not match any observed current official standalone presentation. Supported current-design update to the official standalone mark.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector from BingX's official GitHub organization: the standalone X mark subset of the official logo lockup, preserving original paths, #2A54FF fills and the 0.3-opacity radial-gradient overlays. Standalone brand mark without accompanying text; square-cell suitable as a compact glyph. Supported update over the accepted circle-cutout presentation, which matches no observed current official presentation of the mark.

sources.observation: Official BingX API docs repository (github.com/BingX-API, org-controlled) logo lockup SVG, 84x24 viewBox: standalone X mark at x 0..28.0065, y 0..21.8043 as two mirrored interlocking curved-stroke paths, fill #2A54FF, each overlaid with opacity 0.3 radial gradient (paint0_radial_369_1438); 'BingX' wordmark follows as black letter paths. Original vector, no text inside the mark area.

bingx.com apple-touch-icon.png (120x120, 1401 bytes): blue square field with white X mark centered — current app-icon presentation of the same X mark; square-platform backing, not part of the symbol itself.

bingx.com homepage (fetched via workflow helper, 124629 bytes, receipt evidence/16201/research-5d3857f284724c558697979a80f532b0/fetch-8946ffd3aae34bb2a8fcfefdf21cde9e/receipt.json) is the operating BingX site; og:image share_card.png and site chrome confirm bingx.com as the official domain.
